reviews.title: Great CPU Motherboard Combo
reviews.comment: CPU: Intel i5-14600k Motherboard: Gigabyte B760M Gaming plus WIFI I bought this combo in mid January and have had it for just shy of two months. The motherboard and cpu combo was an upgrade from a i7-7700k system. Also, building a computer is fun. I am very pleased with the purchase. The combo has worked out well for a variety of tasks ranging from productivity to light gaming. Not for folks who like to overclock as the BIOS is very stingy as to what can be done.  However, enabling Intel POR in the BIOS settings gave a significant boost to performance. The BIOS with the motherboard was an older one dated to early 2024. It was not compatible with the 9060 xt GPU. Thus, the BIOS needed to be updated to #7 which dated to Sept 2025. After that, everything worked great. Thus, one may need to update the BIOS to make the combo compatible with current peripheral hardware. I may have been lucky in the 14600k that I purchased as the cpu never gets above 60 C even under the most taxing of tasks. The motherboard has a variety of features including sound, wifi, ethernet port, and two NVMe slots. The NVMe slots are great in that they allow for the ssd to be clipped in rather than screwed. I neither use the wifi nor sound so no comment on those. NVMe and ethernet function as they should. I would recommend not using the latch system built into the motherboard. Rather, I would recommend a LGA 1700 bracket. The 5-star review is due to the stability of the system. This combo has been very stable. With that said, there should be some expectations. The motherboard does not get the most out of the CPU. "Optimized Defaults" settings in the bios gives a R23 score of 16000 +/- 100. The average R23 score for a 14600k is usually around 24000. During the test, the 14600k operates at 3.1GHz so intense throttling. There are no overclocking options, so that is not an option. By disabling "Intel Performance" and using "Intel POR" with under volt the CPU to 1.115, among other setting changes  the R23 score improved to 22150 with the CPU rock steady at 4.6GHz and FPS in games improved by 20% while remaining perfectly stable. The CPU is at 110-118 watts under Future Mark CPU burner and reaches a max of 62C with liquid cooling after 15 minutes and till the end of the 1 hour stability test. Perfectly stable in WoW and other games. All in all, with playing around with settings beyond "Optimized Defaults", this combo can achieve about 90% what a 14600k is capable of. Also, ordered one day and arrived 24 hours later. No fuss. No hassles. All in all, a great cpu motherboard combo.
